agent: mapdraw wave, reader A (land, beaches, camera)
question: What the executable feeds terrain_2_0.fx for the land and the beaches - the mesh, every parameter and texture, the camera's matrices - and how the draws are split.

addresses.name: CProvinceManager_CreateWorld
addresses.comment: **Builds the map renderer's world, once** - one caller, the map object's setup at 0x240905 with the graphics owner's +0x1DC4. 0x450520 to the `ret 4` at 0x455866. Holds the progress strings 'Used RAM before World is created', 'Creating beach manager.', CREATING_BORDERS, CREATING_TEXTS, CREATING_TREES, CREATING_RIVERS, CREATING_THE_WORLD and MAP_PROPERLY_INIT. **Only its tile grid was read** (0x450823..0x450863): tile width and height (+0x194, +0x198) = **50** [exe], columns (+0x18C) = map_width / 50 + 1 and rows (+0x190) = map_height / 50 + 1 (CMap +0x2A74, +0x2A78; integer division) - 113 x 44 for TFH's 5616 x 2160. It calls CProvinceManager_CreateTiles at 0x453E73 and CProvinceManager_CreateMeshes at 0x454E9E. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapdraw.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: 0x850823 `mov eax,0x32` stored to [ebx+0x194] and [ebx+0x198]; 0x850837..0x850863 `[CMap+0x2A74] idiv [ebx+0x194]; inc` into +0x18C and the same with +0x2A78/+0x198 into +0x190; ebx = [ebp+8] at 0x850548; only exit `ret 4` at 0x855866 by cfg walk (5105 instructions). Wrong if a later write in the same body changes +0x194 - stores.py over 0x830000-0x880000 finds +0x194 written only here and at 0x87E808 (another object, ESI-based, not checked).

addresses.name: CProvinceManager_CreateTiles
addresses.comment: **Makes the map tiles** ('Creating province data'). 0x4571F0 to the `ret 4` at 0x4578AD. Allocates columns x rows MapTile records of 0x3C0 bytes into +0x19C (vector new with constructor 0x44EB20). For tile i, col = i % columns, row = i / columns, its **AbsoluteWorldMatrix (+0x13C) = D3DXMatrixTranslation(col x 50 + 25, 0, row x 50 + 25)** - the tile's centre in map pixels, y = 0 [exe] - and it flags the tile's MeshBuffers (+0x24C, +0x270, +0x294 byte +0x14 = 1, and +0x2B8.., +0x2DC.., +0x300.., +0x324.. at +0x2CC/+0x2F0/+0x314/+0x338). Then CProvinceManager_AssignProvincesToTiles and, per tile with provinces, 0x4DD860. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapdraw.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: 0x8574DD..0x857532 operator new of cols*rows*0x3C0 and the vector-constructor call with element size 0x3C0; 0x857562..0x857644: idiv by +0x18C, x = col*[+0x194] + [+0x194]/2, z = row*[+0x198] + [+0x198]/2, call [0xD2B43C] which pefile resolves to d3dx9_42!D3DXMatrixTranslation, result copied (rep movsd 16) to tile +0x13C at 0x857668. Wrong if the import slot were mis-resolved - it is the same slot MapGraphics_Update calls for the per-frame world matrix.

addresses.name: CProvinceManager_AssignProvincesToTiles
addresses.comment: **Puts every province in one map tile** and grows that tile's land rectangle. For each province entry from 1 (mgr +0x2C vector): tile = (entry->+0x10 +0x13C) / tile_width + columns x ((entry->+0x10 +0x140) / tile_height), the province pushed onto the tile's list in the 16-byte-per-tile array handed in; where the template's is_land byte (+0x22) is set, the tile's rectangle (+0x3A0 x, +0x3A4 y, +0x3A8 w, +0x3AC h) becomes the union with the template's bounding box (+0x80..+0x8C, x y w h) - copied whole while w and h are 0. **So a province's whole land mesh lives in one tile, the one holding its centre** - measured on TFH's cache: every one of 10,621 provinces with a land mesh sits in tile (cx / 50) + 113 x (cy / 50), cx = x0 + (x1 - x0 + 1) div 2 over its pixel bounding box (bbox centre rounded up); the 0x13C/0x140 pair itself was not traced. `ret 8`. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapdraw.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: 0x85B4BD..0x85B4F5 the two idivs by +0x194/+0x198 and the tile index; 0x85B551 `cmp byte [eax+0x22],0`; 0x85B576..0x85B62D the rectangle union against template +0x80/+0x84/+0x88/+0x8C. The measurement: scratchpad mapdraw/assign.py, 10621/10621 provinces in tfh/map/cache/all_quads.bin against tfh/map/provinces.bmp; floor((x0+x1)/2) gives 10399, the pixel mean 10217. Wrong if 0x13C/0x140 is not the bbox centre - the measured rule holds either way.

addresses.name: CProvinceManager_CreateMeshes
addresses.comment: **'Creating meshes'**: the map's vertex declarations, its terrain textures and its tile meshes. 0x4578B0 to the `ret 4` at 0x458D82; one caller, CProvinceManager_CreateWorld at 0x454E9E. Seven CreateVertexDeclaration calls from static D3DVERTEXELEMENT9 arrays in .data: **ProvinceVertexDecl (VA 0x170AC40: SHORT2 POSITION0 at 0, SHORT2 TEXCOORD0 at 4; stride 8) into +0x429C - the land's**; ProvinceVertexDecl again (VA 0x170AC58: FLOAT2 POSITION0, D3DCOLOR COLOR0 at 8; stride 12) into +0x42A0 - **the beaches'**; ProvinceWaterVertexDecl (0x170AC90: FLOAT3 POSITION, FLOAT2 TEXCOORD0/1/2) into +0x14; BorderVertexDecl (0x170AC28: SHORT4 POSITION, D3DCOLOR COLOR0) into +0x42A4; WaterBorderDecl (0x170ACB8: SHORT2 POSITION, UBYTE4 TEXCOORD0) into +0x42B0; WaterFarDecl (0x170AC70: FLOAT4 POSITION) into +0x42AC; TerraIncognitaDecl (0x170AC80: FLOAT4 POSITION) into +0x42A8. Then CProvinceManager_LoadTerrainTextures, 'Creating visible from', CProvinceManager_LoadQuads, 'Creating meshes from', border adjacencies, the corner cache and the waves. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapdraw.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: 0x857ABB..0x857C15: device+0x158 (CreateVertexDeclaration, slot 86) seven times with the element pointers and out-pointers listed, each followed by its 'CreateVertexDeclaration failed!! (...)' string; the arrays decoded as D3DVERTEXELEMENT9 (scratchpad mapdraw/decl.py), each ending D3DDECL_END. tfh/map/cache/quad_format.bin holds the same two element lists (SHORT2/SHORT2, FLOAT2/D3DCOLOR). Wrong if something rewrote the .data arrays before this runs - none was looked for.

addresses.name: CProvinceManager_LoadTerrainTextures
addresses.comment: **Loads the map's fixed textures** through the texture handler (0xA60F30, which records each file's width and height at entry +0x24/+0x28), from the map folder's terrain/: base.dds -> +0xB4, colormap.dds -> +0xB8, colormap_political.dds -> +0xBC, stripes.dds -> +0xC0, colormap_water.dds -> +0xC4, terrainalpha.tga -> +0xD0, noise-2d.dds -> +0x17C, water_blur_20_pixels_tilable.dds -> +0x178, water.dds -> +0x188, test_noise.dds -> +0x180, noise_test2.dds -> +0x184 (two copies of the sequence, chosen by the path mode at [0x1A85558]+0x5C); then copies colormap.dds's width and height to +0xC8/+0xCC and builds a 256-entry table at +0xA4 (0x44AFB0; not read). `ret 4`. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapdraw.md, section A.3.
addresses.evidence: Each path string pushed before `call 0xA60F30` and the result stored: 0x858E87 +0xB4, 0x858F06 +0xB8, 0x858F85 +0xBC, 0x859004 +0xC0, 0x859083 +0xC4, 0x859102 +0xD0, 0x859181 +0x17C, 0x859200 +0x178, 0x85927F +0x188, 0x8592FE +0x180, 0x85937D +0x184; 0x85974E/0x859754 the width/height copy. Wrong if 0xA60F30 returned something other than the texture id - the draws index the handler's 0x2C-byte table with these values (0x85E19B).

addresses.name: CProvinceManager_LoadQuads
addresses.comment: **Loads the tile meshes from map/cache**, or rebuilds them. Where cache/all_quads.bin and cache/quad_index.bin both exist and CMap +0x28 (cache stale) is 0, reads quad_index.bin (at most 0x13880 bytes): count, total size, largest record, then count pairs (tile index, byte size); for each pair reads that many bytes of all_quads.bin and hands them to QuadCache_LoadTile(mgr, tile, record); then the tile's terrain-index texture - quad_texture_<tile>.dds in the folder given, loaded by Quad_LoadTerrainIndexTexture after MapTile_SetTerrainIndexRect, or else made from the tile's provinces (0x456FD0, 0x6C-byte entries) by Quad_CreateTerrainIndexTexture. Otherwise CProvinceManager_BuildQuads. `ret 8`. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapdraw.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: 0x859C0B/0x859C35 the two cache names; 0x859DE6/0x859E0C FileExists on both and 0x859E3B `cmp byte [CMap+0x28],0`; 0x85A14D the 0x13880 cap; 0x85A260..0x85A281 the pair loop and QuadCache_LoadTile; 0x85A299 '%squad_texture_%d.dds'. TFH's quad_index.bin: count 1774, total 66,167,662 = the size of all_quads.bin, largest 262,372 = the largest pair - parsing every record by QuadCache_LoadTile's layout consumes each exactly (scratchpad mapdraw/quadraw.py, area.py).

addresses.name: CProvinceManager_BuildQuads
addresses.comment: **Rebuilds the tile meshes and writes the cache** - not read beyond its strings: 'REcreating quads', 'Quad creation <', 'writing quad mesh ', /cache/all_quads.bin, /cache/quad_index.bin, /cache/quad_textures/, and VirtualAlloc of g_pProvinceVertexMemCache, g_pTempVertices, g_pIndexLookup, g_pTempBorderIndices and g_pTempBorderVertices. Called by CProvinceManager_LoadQuads when the cache is missing or stale. `ret 4`. The name is ours (inferred from the strings). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapdraw.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: String references located by scratchpad mapdraw/refs.py inside 0x85A580..0x85B40A (cfg walk, one exit `ret 4`); one caller 0x859E49 in the else-branch of the cache test. Not read: how a province's pixels become triangles, the beach smoothing, the border corners. Wrong as a name if the function only writes the cache and the build is elsewhere.

addresses.name: MapTile_SetTerrainIndexRect
addresses.comment: **The four terrain-index parameters of a tile**: terrain_index_offset (+0x3B0, +0x3B4) = land rectangle x, y (+0x3A0, +0x3A4) less 2; terrain_index_size (+0x3B8, +0x3BC) = rectangle w, h (+0x3A8, +0x3AC) plus 4. **The next power of two is computed and thrown away** - the loops leave it in ESI, which is overwritten before the stores - so the size is the texture's own: TFH's quad_texture_145.dds is 40 x 31 for a rectangle 36 x 27. Bare `ret`. Quad_CreateTerrainIndexTexture holds the same code inline. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapdraw.md, section A.3.
addresses.evidence: 0x857180..0x8571E9: ecx = [+0x3AC]+4, edx = [+0x3A8]+4, the two doubling loops on ESI, then `mov esi,[eax+0x3a0]` and the stores of esi-2, edi-2, edx, ecx. The cache's DDS sizes equal the province-union rectangle plus 4 on both measured tiles (145: 40x31; 1200: 57x68). Wrong if a caller overwrites +0x3B8 afterwards - stores.py finds +0x3B8 written only here and at 0x869ADB.

addresses.name: Quad_CreateTerrainIndexTexture
addresses.signature: void __stdcall Quad_CreateTerrainIndexTexture(WaterObject* mgr, int tile, void* entries, int count, Hoi3CString* textureFolder, void* buffer)
addresses.comment: **A tile's terrain-index texture where the cache has none** - only the head read: the same offset/size computation as MapTile_SetTerrainIndexRect, then quad_texture_<tile>.dds in the folder; if the file exists and the cache is not stale, loaded instead. The making itself is CreateTerrainOffsetTexture (0x469080, not read; its strings 'CreateTerrainOffsetTexture: Failed to create texture for quad' and '...Lock failed'). `ret 0x18`; callers CProvinceManager_LoadQuads (0x45A386) and 0x47358E. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapdraw.md, section A.3.
addresses.evidence: 0x869A60..0x869AE1 read (the rectangle and the stores to +0x3B0..+0x3BC), 0x869AF7 the file name; the rest of the 85 reachable instructions not followed. Argument order from the call at 0x85A380..0x85A386. Wrong in name if the tail does something other than create and save.

addresses.name: Quad_LoadTerrainIndexTexture
addresses.no_signature: The tile index arrives in ECX (`mov edi,ecx` at 0x869B81) beside two stack arguments, mgr at [ebp+8] and a read buffer at [ebp+0xC], `ret 8`; the register argument is not a receiver, so __thiscall would be wrong, and the custom-storage form was not tried against checkSignatures.
addresses.comment: **Loads map/cache/quad_textures/quad_texture_<tile>.dds** ('%s/cache/quad_textures/quad_texture_%d.dds' with 'map') with D3DXCreateTextureFromFileInMemoryEx(width and height D3DX_DEFAULT_NONPOW2, 1 mip level, format from the file, default pool, filter NONE) and stores the texture in tile +0x39C; on failure logs 'failed read quad tex for quad '. TFH's files are A8R8G8B8, no mips, (w+4) x (h+4). The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapdraw.md, section A.3.
addresses.evidence: 0x869B93 the format string; 0x869CA8..0x869CBA the pushes (-2, -2, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, -1, 0, &info, 0, &tex) and `call [0xD2B418]` (D3DXCreateTextureFromFileInMemoryEx by pefile); 0x869D68 the store to tile +0x39C. DDS headers of all 1774 cache files read (scratchpad check): 32-bit ARGB masks, mip count 0.

addresses.name: IndexBuffer_Create
addresses.signature: int __stdcall IndexBuffer_Create(MeshBuffer* mesh, void* device, int count)
addresses.comment: **A 16-bit index buffer for a MeshBuffer** (primitivescontainer.cpp): sets the indexed byte +0x17, the primitive count +0x10 from count by the primitive kind +0x20 (0: count / 3, triangle list; 1: count - 2, strip; 2: count - 1), and CreateIndexBuffer(count x 2, WRITEONLY, D3DFMT_INDEX16, pool managed where +0x14 is set else default) into +0x4. VertexBuffer_Create (0x6D4510) is its pair. `ret 0xC`. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapdraw.md, section A.1.
addresses.evidence: 0xAD48D0..0xAD4937: [esi+0x17]=1, the three-way primitive count, pushes 8 (usage), 0x65 (D3DFMT_INDEX16), count+count, device slot 0x6C (CreateIndexBuffer, IDirect3DDevice9 slot 27), out at esi+4; error path names primitivescontainer.cpp. Wrong if +0x20 holds anything but 0 for the map tiles - the draws pass D3DPT_TRIANGLELIST regardless.

addresses.name: CProvinceManager_ReloadResources
addresses.comment: **Reloads the map's textures and fetches every effect handle again** - and is where the terrain effect's parameter handles are taken by name. Reloads (TextureHandler_ReloadEntry) the sheets, borders, +0x2B8/+0x2BC, the noise and colour maps, recopies colormap.dds's size to +0xC8/+0xCC; looks up the effects by key in the FX handler (CGraphics +0x6BCFC): 'TerrainShader' -> +0x1A0, 'WaterShader' -> +0x234, 'TerraIncognitaShader' -> +0x2AC; then on the terrain effect GetParameterByName: tex0 +0x1A4, tex1 +0x1A8, tex2 +0x1AC, tex3 +0x1B0, WorldViewProjectionMatrix +0x1C0, WorldMatrix +0x1B4, ViewMatrix +0x1B8, ProjectionMatrix +0x1BC, LightDirection +0x1C4, ColorMapHeight +0x1C8, ColorMapWidth +0x1CC, ColorMapTextureHeight +0x1D0, ColorMapTextureWidth +0x1D4, MapWidth +0x1E0, MapHeight +0x1E4, BorderWidth +0x1D8, BorderHeight +0x1DC, and GetTechniqueByName for the eleven techniques +0x208..+0x230. One caller, 0x43B879. `ret 4`. The name is ours (inferred: a reload, by the texture reloads it opens with). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapdraw.md, section A.2.
addresses.evidence: Annotated disassembly 0x868530..0x868F45 (scratchpad mapdraw/ann.py): each name string pushed before effect slot 0x24 (ID3DXEffect::GetParameterByName) or 0x34 (GetTechniqueByName) and the store that follows (0x8688C7..0x868C5C for the terrain effect). terrain_2_0.fx declares no WorldViewProjectionMatrix, so +0x1C0 is null there and both draws test it before SetMatrix. Wrong as a name only.

addresses.name: Camera_GetView
addresses.comment: Slot 91 (+0x16C) of the camera table at VA 0x1601BE0 (no RTTI): `lea eax,[ecx+0x1C8]` - the view matrix, which Camera_RebuildView makes with D3DXMatrixLookAtLH. MapGraphics_DrawScene, MapGraphics_DrawTerrain and _DrawBeaches take ViewMatrix from it on the scene view's camera. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapdraw.md, section A.4.
addresses.evidence: Table VA 0x1601BE0 slot 91 = 0xABE240, body `lea eax,[ecx+0x1c8]; ret`. vtable.py --holding finds it in no RTTI class's table, so no class carries the slot. Wrong if the scene view's camera has a derived table overriding slot 91 - 0xA873F0 builds it with Camera_Construct and writes no other table.

addresses.evidence: Slot 92 = 0xABE250 `lea eax,[ecx+0x208]; ret`; 0xABECCF..0xABECE4 writes the inverse there.

addresses.name: SceneView_Construct

addresses.name: MapGraphics_DrawTerrain
addresses.revises: Comment only: adds every parameter, texture, render and sampler state and the per-tile draw, read 2026-11-06 for FINDINGS-mapdraw.md. The technique switch and texture choice of the old comment are kept as they were.
addresses.comment: **The land, with terrain_2_0.fx, and the far/near switch for it.** 0x45DFB0 to the bare `ret` at 0x45E9AE; the graphics owner in EDI, no stack arguments. level = 1 + the index of the last entry of CMap terrain_sheet_heights (+0x40/+0x44) the camera height is strictly above (0 for none). **Map style (settings +0xF4) 0 - only the Terrain and Weather modes write it - uses TerrainShader_Graphical (+0x208) at every height**; otherwise level 0 TerrainShader_General (+0x210), level above 0 TerrainShader_General_Low (+0x214). **Once, before Begin**: ViewMatrix and ProjectionMatrix from the scene view's camera (WaterObject +0x24 -> +0x1C, slots 91 and 93 - SetMatrix, not transposed); render states ALPHABLENDENABLE 0, SRCBLEND ONE, DESTBLEND ZERO, CULLMODE CCW; LightDirection (12 bytes of the MapSetLight light, +0x416C +0x138); ColorMapHeight 720 and ColorMapWidth 1872 (colormap.dds's own size from its texture-table entry +0x28/+0x24), ColorMapTextureHeight/Width their next powers of two (1024, 2048); MapWidth 5616 and MapHeight 2160 (CMap +0x2A74/+0x2A78); tex0 base.dds (+0xB4); BorderWidth and BorderHeight 50 (+0x194/+0x198); sampler 0 and 1 D3DSAMP_MIPMAPLODBIAS -1.5 under Graphical, -2.5 otherwise; Begin(flags 0). **Per pass**: BeginPass; tex2/tex3 the province colour pair (graphics +0x4168 +0xC/+0x10); tex4 colormap.dds (+0xB8) under Graphical, else colormap_political.dds (+0xBC) with tex7 stripes.dds (+0xC0); tex5 map_overlay_tile.dds (+0x2C0) under General_Low, else noise_test2.dds (+0x184; the selector at VA 0x1A8565C is never written); **tex6 the texture sheet of the level** (+0x288[level]); SetVertexDeclaration ProvinceVertexDecl (+0x429C). **Per visible tile** (the deque at +0x78, count +0x88), skipping one with no land triangles: tex1 = the tile's terrain-index texture (+0x39C) with TerrainIndexOffsetX/Y and TerrainIndexSizeX/Y (+0x3B0..+0x3BC, handles fetched by name every tile); WorldMatrix (+0x17C), AbsoluteWorldMatrix (+0x13C, by name); CommitChanges; SetStreamSource(0, tile +0x270, 0, stride 8); SetIndices(tile +0x250); DrawIndexedPrimitive(TRIANGLELIST, 0, 0, vertices +0x27C, 0, triangles +0x25C). **After**: EndPass, End, LOD bias 0 on samplers 0 and 1, SRCBLEND SRCALPHA, DESTBLEND INVSRCALPHA, CULLMODE NONE. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapdraw.md, section A.2, and FINDINGS-farmap.md, section A.
addresses.evidence: Annotated disassembly of 0x85DFB0..0x85E9AE (scratchpad mapdraw/ann.py) against the IDirect3DDevice9 and ID3DXEffect slot orders: device +0xE4 SetRenderState (0x1B 0, 0x13 2, 0x14 1, 0x16 3 at 0x85E09A..0x85E0E4; 0x13 5, 0x14 6, 0x16 1 at 0x85E978..0x85E9A7), +0x114 SetSamplerState(0/1, 8, -1.5 [0x160A7AC] or -2.5 [0x171DE14]), +0x15C SetVertexDeclaration, +0x190 SetStreamSource, +0x1A0 SetIndices, +0x148 DrawIndexedPrimitive with 4; effect +0xE8 SetTechnique, +0xFC Begin, +0x100 BeginPass, +0x98 SetMatrix, +0x78 SetFloat, +0x50 SetValue, +0xD0 SetTexture, +0x24 GetParameterByName, +0x104 CommitChanges, +0x108 EndPass, +0x10C End. Handle names from CProvinceManager_ReloadResources.

addresses.name: MapGraphics_DrawBeaches
addresses.revises: Comment only: adds the parameters, textures, states and the per-tile draw, read 2026-11-06 for FINDINGS-mapdraw.md; the technique switch is kept.
addresses.comment: **The beach strips, with terrain_2_0.fx's beach techniques** - the same switch as the land: map style 0 BeachShader_Graphical (+0x218) at every height, otherwise level 0 (camera height not above any terrain_sheet_heights entry) BeachShader_General (+0x220) and above BeachShader_General_Low (+0x224). 0x45EF50 to the bare `ret` at 0x45F6DE, the graphics owner in EDI; called unconditionally by MapGraphics_DrawScene at 0x45C0DB, after the land. **Before**: render states ALPHABLENDENABLE 1, SRCBLEND SRCALPHA, DESTBLEND ZERO (the Graphical and General passes set their own blend and alpha test; General_Low keeps these); cull left as the land left it, NONE; ColorMapHeight/Width (no TextureHeight/Width: those keep the land's), MapWidth/MapHeight; Begin(0) and BeginPass(0) **before** the rest: ViewMatrix and ProjectionMatrix of the scene view's camera, LightDirection; tex4 colormap.dds under Graphical, else colormap_political.dds with tex0 base.dds; tex2 the first province colour lookup (+0x4168 +0xC) - **tex3, tex5 and tex7 are not set here and keep what the land's draw left in the effect**; tex6 the level's sheet; BorderWidth/BorderHeight 50; sampler 0 LOD bias -1.7 under Graphical, -2.5 otherwise; the beach declaration (+0x42A0). **Per visible tile** with beach vertices (+0x2C4): tex1 and the four TerrainIndex values as for the land, WorldMatrix, AbsoluteWorldMatrix; where the beach index buffer has triangles (+0x2EC): CommitChanges, SetStreamSource(0, +0x2B8, 0, stride 12), SetIndices(+0x2E0), DrawIndexedPrimitive(TRIANGLELIST, 0, 0, +0x2C4, 0, +0x2EC). **After**: EndPass, End, LOD bias 0 on sampler 0, SRCBLEND SRCALPHA, DESTBLEND INVSRCALPHA, CULLMODE NONE. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapdraw.md, section A.2.
addresses.evidence: Annotated disassembly of 0x85EF50..0x85F6DE: SetRenderState 0x1B 1, 0x13 5, 0x14 1 at 0x85EFE3..0x85F018; Begin 0x85F167 and BeginPass 0x85F177 before the SetMatrix calls at 0x85F196/0x85F1B4; tex4/tex0 at 0x85F23B..0x85F2BF, tex2 only at 0x85F2E1, tex6 at 0x85F321; SetSamplerState(0, 8, -1.7 [0x160A67C] / -2.5) at 0x85F3A4; tile loop 0x85F3D4..0x85F640 with the +0x2C4/+0x2C8 and +0x2E8/+0x2EC skips; no SetTexture of tex3/tex5/tex7 or SetRenderState 0x16 before the loop in the whole body.

structs.name: MapTile
structs.comment: One 50 x 50 square of the map in the map renderer (WaterObject / CProvinceManager +0x19C, columns x rows of them, index = col + columns x row). Holds the land, border and beach meshes of the provinces whose centre lies in it, its two world matrices and its terrain-index texture. No vftable; the name is ours.
structs.evidence: Element size 0x3C0 in the vector new at 0x857509..0x857532 (constructor 0x44EB20) and every index `imul reg,reg,0x3c0` + [mgr+0x19C] (0x85E6CF, 0x85F413, 0x874985, 0x85A2C5).

struct_fields.name: province_index_starts
struct_fields.comment: Begin of an int vector, N+1 entries: the start of each province's group in the land index buffer, the last the total. QuadCache_LoadTile fills it. Its readers were not looked for.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x874A6E `lea esi,[edi+0x20]`, reserve N+1 (0x4C0700), push 0, then push last + B/2 per group (0x874AA0..0x874B2B).

struct_fields.name: visible
struct_fields.comment: Set by MapGraphics_Update each time the camera moves: 1 where the tile is drawn this frame - inside the map camera's frustum, or wrapped round the map's east-west seam. The visible tiles' indices are queued at WaterObject +0x78.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x85CA06 cleared, 0x85CC74 and 0x85CD4A set (after 0xABF670 against the frustum), read at 0x85CC8A and 0x85CF99.

struct_fields.name: absolute_world_matrix
struct_fields.comment: **AbsoluteWorldMatrix**: D3DXMatrixTranslation(col x 50 + 25, 0, row x 50 + 25), made once by CProvinceManager_CreateTiles. Set on the terrain effect by name for every tile, land and beach.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x857644 D3DXMatrixTranslation, rep movsd 16 to tile +0x13C (0x857668); 0x85E84E/0x85F592 `lea edx,[esi+0x13c]` with 'AbsoluteWorldMatrix' to effect SetMatrix (slot 0x98).

struct_fields.name: world_matrix
struct_fields.comment: **WorldMatrix**: D3DXMatrixTranslation(tile centre x - camera x_settled (MapCamera +0x33C), 0, tile centre z - camera y_settled (+0x340)), shifted by the map width (CMap +0x2A74) either way where the tile is nearer across the seam - so the scene is drawn camera-relative. Remade by MapGraphics_Update whenever the camera moves.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x85C7B2/0x85C7BA camera +0x340/+0x33C; 0x85CA9C..0x85CAE9 centre minus camera; 0x85CC00..0x85CC7C the seam shift; 0x85CF62..0x85CF6F D3DXMatrixTranslation into +0x17C; set as WorldMatrix (+0x1B4 handle) at 0x85E835 and 0x85F579.

struct_fields.name: world_matrix_inverse
struct_fields.comment: D3DXMatrixInverse of world_matrix, made beside it. Readers not looked for.

struct_fields.name: world_view_projection
struct_fields.comment: world_matrix x the scene view's view x projection, made each frame by MapGraphics_Update; set as WorldViewProjectionMatrix, which terrain_2_0.fx does not declare (handle null, skipped).
struct_fields.evidence: 0x85D58A..0x85D5B3 D3DXMatrixMultiply(+0x1FC, +0x17C, view) then by the projection; 0x85E80A/0x85F54E guarded by the +0x1C0 handle.

struct_fields.name: land_indices
struct_fields.comment: The land's 16-bit index buffer (at +0x250 = MeshBuffer +4), every province group of the tile concatenated; vertex count +0x258 (0 here), primitive count +0x25C. MapGraphics_DrawTerrain skips the tile where both are 0.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x874B9D IndexBuffer_Create on tile+0x24C; draw 0x85E6DB/0x85E6E4 tests +0x258/+0x25C, 0x85E8AD SetIndices(+0x250), 0x85E8BF primitive count +0x25C.

struct_fields.name: land_vertices
struct_fields.comment: The land's vertex buffer (+0x270), ProvinceVertexDecl: SHORT2 position (tile-local map pixels, from the tile centre) and SHORT2 TEXCOORD0 = (province id & 0xFF, province id >> 8); stride +0x288 = 8, vertex count +0x27C.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x874A06 VertexBuffer_Create(tile+0x270, count V/8, stride 8); draw 0x85E890..0x85E8AB SetStreamSource(0, +0x270, 0, +0x288), DrawIndexedPrimitive NumVertices +0x27C.

struct_fields.name: beach_vertices
struct_fields.comment: The beach strip's vertex buffer, the beaches' declaration: FLOAT2 position (tile-local, already on the half-pixel) and D3DCOLOR with R = province id & 0xFF, G = province id >> 8, B = A = 0; stride +0x2D0 = 12, vertex count +0x2C4.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x874DA0 VertexBuffer_Create(tile+0x2B8, W/12, 12); draw 0x85F5E6..0x85F601 SetStreamSource(0, +0x2B8, 0, +0x2D0), NumVertices +0x2C4. B and A zero in all 667,511 of TFH's cached beach vertices.

struct_fields.name: beach_indices
struct_fields.comment: The beach strip's 16-bit index buffer (+0x2E0); primitive count +0x2EC (triangle list).
struct_fields.evidence: 0x874E5C IndexBuffer_Create(tile+0x2DC, X/2); draw 0x85F603 SetIndices(+0x2E0), 0x85F615 primitive count +0x2EC.

struct_fields.name: terrain_index_texture
struct_fields.comment: IDirect3DTexture9* of the tile's terrain-index texture (quad_texture_<tile>.dds): set as tex1 for the land and the beaches of the tile. Null skips the tex1 and TerrainIndex settings for the tile.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x869D68 store; 0x85E6F1/0x85F435 read, SetTexture with the tex1 handle (+0x1A8) at 0x85E716/0x85F45A.

struct_fields.name: land_rect_x
struct_fields.comment: The union of the tile's land provinces' bounding boxes (template +0x80..+0x8C): x, map pixels.

struct_fields.name: land_rect_y
struct_fields.comment: The land rectangle's y (engine y: 0 in the south).

struct_fields.name: land_rect_w
struct_fields.comment: The land rectangle's width.

struct_fields.name: land_rect_h
struct_fields.comment: The land rectangle's height.

struct_fields.name: terrain_index_offset_x
struct_fields.comment: **TerrainIndexOffsetX** = land_rect_x - 2, set as a float by name for every tile drawn.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x8571D6 store; 0x85E774..0x85E795 SetFloat on the handle fetched by name 'TerrainIndexOffsetX'.

struct_fields.name: terrain_index_offset_y
struct_fields.comment: **TerrainIndexOffsetY** = land_rect_y - 2.

struct_fields.name: terrain_index_size_x
struct_fields.comment: **TerrainIndexSizeX** = land_rect_w + 4: the terrain-index texture's width (the power of two computed beside it is discarded).

struct_fields.name: terrain_index_size_y
struct_fields.comment: **TerrainIndexSizeY** = land_rect_h + 4.

struct_fields.name: visible_tiles
struct_fields.comment: Start of a std::deque of the tile indices MapGraphics_Update found visible, in tile order; the land and beach draws walk it (0x46B620 indexes it). Count at +0x88.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x85E691..0x85E6CC and 0x85F3D5..0x85F410: `lea ecx,[edi+0x78]; call 0x86B620`, the deque block arithmetic, tile index -> +0x19C.

struct_fields.name: visible_tile_count
struct_fields.comment: How many tiles are queued at +0x78 this frame: the loop bound of MapGraphics_DrawTerrain and _DrawBeaches.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x85E678 and 0x85F3B4 `mov reg,[edi+0x88]` as the loop count.

struct_fields.name: tex_base
struct_fields.comment: Texture id of terrain/base.dds: tex0 of the terrain effect (BaseTexture/TreeTexture), which none of the land or beach techniques samples.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x858E87 store; 0x85E33C..0x85E376 SetTexture with the tex0 handle +0x1A4.

struct_fields.name: colormap_width
struct_fields.comment: colormap.dds's width as the file has it (1872 in TFH), copied from its texture-table entry.

struct_fields.name: colormap_height
struct_fields.comment: colormap.dds's height (720 in TFH).

struct_fields.name: tex_terrainalpha
struct_fields.comment: Texture id of terrain/terrainalpha.tga. Readers not looked for.

struct_fields.name: tex_noise_2d
struct_fields.comment: Texture id of terrain/noise-2d.dds: tex5 of the land under Graphical/General where the global at VA 0x1A8565C is neither 0 nor 1.

struct_fields.name: tex_test_noise
struct_fields.comment: Texture id of terrain/test_noise.dds: tex5 where the global at VA 0x1A8565C is 1.

struct_fields.name: tex_noise_test2
struct_fields.comment: Texture id of terrain/noise_test2.dds: **tex5 (NoiseTexture) of the land under Graphical and General**, the global at VA 0x1A8565C being 0 - the only reference to that .bss global in .text is the read (inferred: always 0).
struct_fields.evidence: 0x85937D store; 0x85E596..0x85E59F; refs.py finds 0x1A8565C only at 0x85E597, and the same scan finds that known read (positive control).

struct_fields.name: tile_columns
struct_fields.comment: Map tile columns: map_width / 50 + 1 (113 in TFH).

struct_fields.name: tile_rows
struct_fields.comment: Map tile rows: map_height / 50 + 1 (44 in TFH).

struct_fields.name: tile_width
struct_fields.comment: 50 [exe]; also BorderWidth of the terrain effect.

struct_fields.name: tile_height
struct_fields.comment: 50 [exe]; also BorderHeight.

struct_fields.name: tiles
struct_fields.comment: The map tiles, columns x rows, 0x3C0 bytes each.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x85754E store; every tile index is `imul 0x3c0` + this.

struct_fields.name: h_tex0
struct_fields.comment: Terrain effect parameter handle 'tex0'.

struct_fields.name: h_tex1
struct_fields.comment: Handle 'tex1': the tile's terrain-index texture (QuadIndexTexture).

struct_fields.name: h_tex2
struct_fields.comment: Handle 'tex2': the first province colour lookup (graphics +0x4168 -> +0xC).

struct_fields.name: h_tex3
struct_fields.comment: Handle 'tex3': the second province colour lookup (+0x4168 -> +0x10); set by the land draw only, the beaches inherit it.

struct_fields.name: h_WorldMatrix
struct_fields.comment: Handle 'WorldMatrix' (MapTile world_matrix).

struct_fields.name: h_ViewMatrix
struct_fields.comment: Handle 'ViewMatrix' (the scene view camera's slot 91).

struct_fields.name: h_ProjectionMatrix
struct_fields.comment: Handle 'ProjectionMatrix' (the scene view camera's slot 93).

struct_fields.name: h_WorldViewProjectionMatrix
struct_fields.comment: Handle 'WorldViewProjectionMatrix' - null with terrain_2_0.fx, which does not declare it.

struct_fields.name: h_LightDirection
struct_fields.comment: Handle 'LightDirection', given 12 bytes from the MapSetLight light (+0x416C, its +0x138..+0x140); no land or beach shader of TFH reads it.

struct_fields.name: h_ColorMapHeight
struct_fields.comment: Handle 'ColorMapHeight' = colormap.dds height (720).

struct_fields.name: h_ColorMapWidth
struct_fields.comment: Handle 'ColorMapWidth' = colormap.dds width (1872).

struct_fields.name: h_ColorMapTextureHeight
struct_fields.comment: Handle 'ColorMapTextureHeight' = the next power of two at or above the colormap height (1024).

struct_fields.name: h_ColorMapTextureWidth
struct_fields.comment: Handle 'ColorMapTextureWidth' = next power of two of the width (2048).

struct_fields.name: h_BorderWidth
struct_fields.comment: Handle 'BorderWidth' = tile_width, 50.

struct_fields.name: h_BorderHeight
struct_fields.comment: Handle 'BorderHeight' = tile_height, 50.

struct_fields.name: h_MapWidth
struct_fields.comment: Handle 'MapWidth' = CMap map_width (5616).

struct_fields.name: h_MapHeight
struct_fields.comment: Handle 'MapHeight' = CMap map_height (2160).

struct_fields.name: land_vertex_declaration
struct_fields.comment: IDirect3DVertexDeclaration9 'ProvinceVertexDecl': SHORT2 POSITION0, SHORT2 TEXCOORD0 (stride 8). Set once before the land's tile loop.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x857B00 CreateVertexDeclaration into it from VA 0x170AC40; 0x85E666 SetVertexDeclaration (device slot 0x15C).

struct_fields.name: beach_vertex_declaration
struct_fields.comment: IDirect3DVertexDeclaration9 for the beaches (logged as ProvinceVertexDecl too): FLOAT2 POSITION0, D3DCOLOR COLOR0 (stride 12).

struct_fields.name: look_eye
struct_fields.comment: The Camera base's eye, for D3DXMatrixLookAtLH (Camera_SetEye; copy at +0x11C). UpdateMapCamera sets it from +0x2E8, (0, height, 0).

struct_fields.name: look_at
struct_fields.comment: The Camera base's look-at point (Camera_SetAt; copy at +0x128), from +0x2F4: (0, -8, 0) with always_counters, (0, 12, 30) without.

struct_fields.name: look_up
struct_fields.comment: The Camera base's up vector, (0, 1, 0) from Camera_Construct.

struct_fields.name: fov_y
struct_fields.comment: Camera base: the vertical field of view, 0.785 for the map camera.
struct_fields.evidence: Camera_Construct 0xABE2F8, read back at 0xABE3A3 for PerspectiveFovLH.

struct_fields.name: aspect
struct_fields.comment: Camera base: width over height (the graphics' +0x6B9BC / +0x6B9C0 for the map camera). Slot 98 (0xABE690) sets it and rebuilds.

struct_fields.name: near_plane
struct_fields.comment: Camera base: near plane, 8.

struct_fields.name: far_plane
struct_fields.comment: Camera base: far plane, 1200 for the map camera (250 for the in-game scene view's camera).

struct_fields.name: projection
struct_fields.comment: Camera base: D3DXMatrixPerspectiveFovLH(fov_y, aspect, near, far) (OrthoRH where the byte +0x144 is set). Camera_GetProjection.

struct_fields.name: view_projection
struct_fields.comment: Camera base: view x projection, Camera_UpdateViewProjection.

struct_fields.name: view
struct_fields.comment: Camera base: D3DXMatrixLookAtLH(look_eye, look_at, look_up). Camera_GetView.

struct_fields.name: view_inverse
struct_fields.comment: Camera base: inverse of view. Camera_GetViewInverse.
